    Kronecker bricks of regular dimension #

    The dimension of a transport H of a structure on G is dim G when the anchored family is small (Bricks.Anchored.dim_transport). Transporting the rigid map system of a regular uncountable cardinal κ > |k| along the countable T_Λ seed gives a Kronecker brick of dimension κ (Bricks.exists_brick_regular).

    Module.rank k G ≤ Module.rank k ↥(σ.tV Gs)
